summary: The channel function table (gk110_chan) describes per-channel resources: an instance block (inst) that holds PBDMA state, a USERD area (userd) containing the command-buffer put/get pointers visible to the GPU driver, and a RAMFC block (ramfc) that the PBDMA reads to fetch commands. The table provides bind/unbind to attach or detach a channel, start/stop to enable or disable it, and preempt for GPU preemption. On channel bind the driver writes the instance-block address and runlist ID to channel control registers (0x800000–0x800004), then writes a full set of RAMFC state values (command-buffer base address, size, USERD address, privilege flag, channel ID) into the instance block before calling nvkm_done to commit the changes.

inst.what: Channel instance block descriptor: 4 KB size with zero-fill and virtual-memory mapping flags

userd.what: USERD (user-visible) area descriptor: BAR 1, 0x200 bytes size, clear function for shadow registers

ramfc.what: RAMFC (RAM Fetch) block descriptor: write function for PBDMA state, 0xfff device-memory mask, privileged execution flag

bind.what: Sets the runlist ID in the channel control register at 0x800004 then calls gk104_chan_bind_inst to write the instance-block address to 0x800000

unbind.what: Writes zero to the channel instance-block register at 0x800000 + (chan->id * 8) to detach the channel from the PBDMA

start.what: Sets the channel-enable bit (0x00000400) in the channel control register at 0x800004 + (chan->id * 8)

stop.what: Clears the channel-enable bit (0x00000800) in the channel control register at 0x800004 + (chan->id * 8) to halt the PBDMA

preempt.what: Delegates to the compute-group preempt function if one is registered, otherwise calls gf100_chan_preempt which writes the channel ID to register 0x002634

inst.size.what: Channel instance block is allocated as a 0x1000-byte (4 KB) region

inst.zero.what: The instance block must be zero-filled when the channel is created

inst.vmm.what: The instance block uses virtual memory mapping through the GPU VMM subsystem

userd.bar.what: The USERD area resides in BAR 1 (the device memory BAR used for channel command buffers)

userd.size.what: The USERD area size is 0x200 bytes

userd.clear.what: Maps the USERD memory and writes zero to ten shadow-register locations (0x040, 0x044, 0x048, 0x04c, 0x050, 0x058, 0x05c, 0x060, 0x088, 0x08c) then unmaps the memory

ramfc.write.what: Maps the instance block and writes thirteen 32-bit values: USERD base address (0x08, 0x0c), magic 0x0000face (0x10), 0xfffff902 (0x30), command-buffer offset (0x48, 0x4c), 0x20400000 (0x84), devm mask (0x94), 0x00000100 (0x9c), 0x0000001f (0xac), privilege flag (0xe4), channel ID (0xe8), 0xf8000000 (0xb8), 0x10003080 (0xf8), 0x10000010 (0xfc) then calls nvkm_done

ramfc.devm.what: The PBDMA device-memory mask is 0xfff, written at instance-block offset 0x94

ramfc.priv.what: Channels run in privileged mode by default, setting bit 0x20 at instance-block offset 0xe4
